comment: * Helper for accessing ColorFilter APIs on various API levels of the platform

methods.name: public static ColorFilter createBlendModeColorFilterCompat(int color, @NonNull BlendModeCompat blendModeCompat)
methods.comment:
* Convenience method to create ColorFilter in a backward-compatible way.
     *
     * This method falls back on PorterDuffColorFilter for API levels that do not support
     * BlendModeColorFilter. This method returns {@code null} if the BlendMode provided is not
     * supported on a given API level.

methodNames: public static ColorFilter createBlendModeColorFilterCompat(int color, @NonNull BlendModeCompat blendModeCompat)
